nodes.name: Rear Shock Damping Mechanism
nodes.description: Rear suspension linkage damping mechanism designed to control motion during compression and extension cycles.

damping_motion_control.name: Motion Control
damping_motion_control.note: Damping occurs both on compression and extension cycles

evidence.quote:
The term “shock” or “rear shock” is the rear suspension linkage damping
mechanism. Like the damping systems in the front fork, the rear shock is
designed to help control motion.

nodes.name: Pressurized Air Return Spring Chamber
nodes.description: Built-in container with pressurized air that compresses when the stanchion moves into the shock body, extending the linkage back after load passes.

spring_system.name: Return Spring Type
spring_system.note: Built-in container with pressurized air compresses under load

evidence.quote:
The shock may
have a built-in container with pressurized air. As the bike hits a bump, the
rear linkage moves upward making the shock stanchion move into the shock
body. This compresses an air chamber, which provides a push to extend back
the linkage after the load is passed.

nodes.name: Large External Shock Spring
nodes.description: Large external spring surrounding the damper, available in different compressive strengths.

spring_type.name: Spring Form
spring_type.note: Large external spring surrounding the damper

evidence.quote:
The rear shock may also have a large external spring surrounding the
damper. These springs are typically available in different compressive
strengths.

nodes.name: Rear Shock Frame Attachment Bushing
nodes.description: Bushing of the frame attachments on the rear shock, which can develop wear resulting in play when lifted up and down.

wear_inspection.name: Play Diagnostic Test
wear_inspection.note: Play felt when bike is lifted up and down with foot on pedal

evidence.quote:
The rear shock can develop wear at the bushing of the frame attachments.
Play is felt when the bike is lifted up and down.

nodes.name: Shock Stanchion Seal
nodes.description: Seal or bushing through which the shock stanchion passes, which may develop leakage at the seals.

leakage_inspection.name: Inspection Area
leakage_inspection.note: Inspect around base of stanchion as it enters the shock body

evidence.quote:
The shock stanchion also passes through a seal or bushing which may
develop leakage at the seals.
